title: AI-directed voxel extraction and volume EM identify intrusions as sites of mitochondrial contact.
summary: AI-directed voxel extraction and volume electron microscopy reveal mitochondrial intrusions as sites of organelle contact.
ai_technology: The source uses focused-ion-beam SEM in HeLa cells and AI segmentation/voxel extraction to locate and inspect contacts; Results identify intrusions at contact sites.
organization: Monash University; Walter and Eliza Hall Institute of Medical Research; University of Melbourne; Aligning Science Across Parkinson's Collaborative Research Network

evidence.tested: AI-directed voxel extraction and volume electron microscopy reveal mitochondrial intrusions as sites of organelle contact. Cell-line ultrastructure supports a cellular mechanism candidate, not a general in-vivo physiological claim.
